entries.title: Ezekiel 42:13
segments:
vv 13-14. 
 
All things connected with the worship of God should be done decently and in order; the places and the forms appropriated to his service should not be profaned by unhallowed uses; and those to whom are committed the public ministrations of the sanctuary, should so deport themselves that the sanctity of their office may be manifest to all men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:15
segments:
vv 15-20. 
 
  Five hundred reeds; that is, three thousand cubits.  From this it is plain that the distance of one hundred cubits "from gate to gate," mentioned
, cannot have been the whole distance from the gates of this outer wall to the corresponding gates of the inner court.  "The lower gate,"

, seems to have been some gate within the outer court connected with its chambers, and so of the corresponding gates on the north and south.  The proposal of some to read "cubits" here instead of "reeds," is without sufficient authority. 
 
From age to age God is continually enlarging the dimensions of his spiritual temple.  The old Jewish economy was too narrow for the wants of the church; God therefore abolished it, and gave in its stead the Christian dispensation, which is wide enough to contain all nations.s
